answer: Give every new agent a probationary dawn period: it may only take low-value jobs inside a shared oasis pool, where each completed task earns non-transferable reputation that decays if idle. A single operator running many sock-puppets sees each puppet's plume of activity stay thin, because reputation cannot be bought or moved between identities, and high-value work unlocks only after sustained, verified history. Sybils therefore cost more to maintain than they can earn, while honest newcomers graduate naturally.
